instructions: Respond in Polish by default unless the user explicitly asks for another language. Keep explanations concise and technical.

daily-flow.description: Start a full Polish Graphify + memory workflow
daily-flow.template: Work in Polish. First read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md if it exists and use Graphify context for the current repo. Then search Qdrant memory for similar past decisions or questions. After that, answer the current task briefly and concretely. If the task changes code or repo state, end by preparing a short session summary that can be stored in memory.

graph-context.description: Use Graphify context for the current repo
graph-context.template: Read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md first if it exists. Prefer graphify query, graphify path, or graphify explain for cross-module questions. Then answer using the graph before scanning raw files. Include the most relevant connected modules, god nodes, and likely impact zones for the current task.

session-summary.description: Summarize the current OpenCode session for later memory
session-summary.template: Summarize the current task in 5 bullets: what changed, what was decided, what is pending, which files were touched, and what should happen next. Keep it concise and action-oriented. If the repo graph is available, mention the most relevant connected modules or communities.

review-impact.description: Review the impact of recent repository changes
review-impact.template: Review the recent changes in this repository. Use git diff or git log output if available, then correlate the result with Graphify context. Explain the behavioral impact, related modules, and any missing tests or validation steps.
